content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"An experienced worker can obtain formal recognition for skills learned outside a training course through the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 - Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) scheme [E01]. The process involves: (1) registering on the Skill India Digital platform [E03], (2) undergoing pre-screening by certified trainers to assess existing skills at no cost [E01][E03], (3) completing mandatory orientation/training of minimum 30 hours [E01], and (4) undergoing assessment and certification by NCVET-approved Awarding Bodies [E01]. Upon passing with 70% or higher marks, candidates receive an industry-relevant graded Skill Certificate [E02], along with one-year accidental insurance and a T-shirt [E01].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E02","E03"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"RPL scheme certifies candidates with prior learning experience or skills","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"Pre-screening is conducted at no cost to assess existing skills","evidence_ids":["E01","E03"]},{"claim":"Minimum 30 hours of mandatory orientation/training is required","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"Assessment and certification is conducted by NCVET-approved Awarding Bodies","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"Candidates receive a graded Skill Certificate upon passing with 70% or higher marks","evidence_ids":["E02"]},{"claim":"Candidates receive one-year accidental insurance and a T-shirt","evidence_ids":["E01"]}]}
